_note: PLACEHOLDER limits and prices -- the real ones are Boril's business decision (see README, 'Plans and billing'). Every limit and default the backend applies to a plan is here (PLAN-002): each plan's entitlements are what the backend enforces, and nothing checks a plan's name. null = unlimited; the counts of a use (maxExports, maxPdfPages, maxOcrPages, maxTranslationCharacters, maxBatchJobs, maxAiOperations) are per calendar month (UTC). maxDocuments, maxDocumentSizeMb, maxAiOperations, maxTemplates and maxStorageMb keep the values they had; the monthly limits added with PLAN-001 are the implementation brief's hypotheses (section 64). OCR, translation and batch jobs don't exist yet: their limits are here so every plan is complete, and apply once those features do. defaultPlan: the plan of a workspace without a subscription in good standing. Stripe price ids come from the environment (STRIPE_PRICE_PRO, STRIPE_PRICE_BUSINESS), not from here.
